summary.intent: Ship a stack of PRs for the callisto-graph release provider, finishing with a split of the large registry.rs file into smaller ecosystem-specific modules.
summary.outcome: Stacked PR #393 on #391 (as stack #394), then split registry.rs mechanically with a script; it compiled cleanly first try, all 146 provider tests passed unchanged, full CI ran, and the registry split PR was shipped.

repo: Provider tests live in their own files, so a registry.rs split does not require moving or editing tests.
The release provider code is in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/provider/, with registry.rs as the large file being decomposed by ecosystem.
PRs are managed as stacks (e.g. #393 on #391 became stack #394), so follow-on work is branched off the prior PR.

code.finding: Split into ecosystem-specific modules using a scripted mechanical split based on an outline of item line numbers; no visibility or import fixes were needed afterward.

workflow: Outlining a file's items with line numbers first, then scripting the split, made a large refactor mechanical and low-risk.
Compile, then format and run targeted tests, then full CI, before opening the PR gives a quick feedback ladder.
Keeping scripts and PR body drafts in /tmp (split-registry.py, body-split.md) keeps the repo clean.
